name: Chumpy 0.9.264
body:
- Subscription avatar caching
- Bugfix: the pinned row's pin display
- Bugfix: the server rows' size on the Servers screen

name: Chumpy 0.8.257
body:
- **Subscription avatars** — panels can send their logo in the `profile-logo` header; Chumpy downloads it on refresh (PNG or SVG, up to 2 MB) and caches it locally. The current subscription's card and every row in the subscription list wear it instead of the stock icon; a missing, empty or invalid header falls back to the default one
- **The subscription list's pick mark** — the selected subscription's tile squares itself off (the card's own shape); the rest stay circles
- **Sort the servers list** — by name, ping or last use, from a chip in the Servers header; true reorders spring into place, the chip keeps its color while the menu stands, and the count in the header covers all servers, not just the visible fold
- **Faster servers page on weak devices** — hand-laid server rows (no per-row Material machinery), row menus built only when first opened, one shared selection float, the ping hand-over animation gated off in simple transitions; the page no longer composes twice on open
- **Adaptive ping concurrency** (@yearningss) — the sweep scales its parallel pings with the list size: one concurrent ping per ten servers
- **Mihomo YAML routing rules** (@yearningss) — inline routing rules import from YAML subscriptions; `PROCESS-NAME` rules skipped where they don't apply
- **Dark launcher icon** — recolored to white on `#191919`, and the in-app icon preview no longer shows the wrong color

name: Chumpy 0.7.241
body:
- Background update checks: a chip on the home screen and a banner on About
- Update downloads with pause, resume from where it stopped, and cancel
- Live update notification (Android 16): percent in the status bar, Pause/Resume and Cancel buttons in the shade
- "Ready to install" once downloaded — tap installs the APK (FileProvider, with the system's unknown-sources ask on first run)
- Wavy progress on the About banner while it downloads; the card never changes size
- Manual "Check for updates" on About — the mark spins while the check runs
- Long-press the chip to hide that version until the next one lands
- APK picked by the device's own ABI; the universal build dropped
- TV controls, secure phone imports and memory improvements (@yearningss)
- Subscription geodata: safe preparation and delay probe retries (@yearningss)
- Geodata sources from Happ routing headers, parsing hardening (@yearningss, @avitoras)
- Fixed the phone wallpaper race — a successful import no longer reports a failure
- Wallpaper imports narrate every outcome: success, cancel, empty picker, palette errors
- The repository moved to the ChumpyXray organization

name: Chumpy 0.6.221
body:
## Новое в этой версии

- **Поддержка горизонтального/планшетного режима** — на широких экранах оболочка разделяется на две панели: Home держит левую сторону, экраны едут рядом.
- **Минимальная поддержка навигации с пульта/контроллеров** (ещё не готово до конца): курсор ходит по активному экрану и навбару, BACK призывает навбар, второй BACK — на главный экран; после выбора вкладки курсор сразу падает на верхний элемент экрана.
- **x86_64-билд** для PC и эмуляторов (пока не протестирован) — во вложениях.

## Из PR #3 от @yearningss

- SOCKS неверно импортировался — исправлено.
- Clash YAML при импорте давал сбой — исправлено.
- GeoData поправлены: раньше корректно работало только на РФ.
- Сохранение статистики при перезапуске ядра — починено.
- Логи больше не съедаются.
- При большом количестве серверов список лагал — переделан на LazyColumn.

name: 0.5.201 — pins, hidden servers, LAN bypass
body:
**What's new**

- **Pin subscriptions** — pin one from its row; pinned sit on top of the list wearing a small pin badge
- **Hide servers** — the row menu hides a server; the eye chip in the Servers header counts the hidden, a tap reveals them back in place — dimmed and eye-marked until unhidden. Hidden servers survive subscription refreshes
- **Expired subscriptions** — a red chip on Home and in Servers once a subscription runs out; the days left in the picker wear the same red
- **Mask addresses** — a new Interface setting: addresses disappear from the UI — server rows keep the protocol only, Home, the connection screen and the VPN notification keep names only
- **Bypass the local network** — the tunnel claims the public internet only now: LAN traffic, broadcasts and multicast ride the physical network, and KDE Connect and friends live. On by default; a Connection setting turns it off
- **Xray core updated to 26.10.31**
- Fixes: subscription imports, persistence, VPN lifecycle

**Which file**
- `arm64-v8a` — most phones
- `armeabi-v7a` — old 32-bit ones
- `universal` — both cores aboard; works anywhere, twice the weight

Android 8.0 or newer.

name: 0.4.171 — the first public build
body:
First public build. Alpha software — it will crash on you somewhere; when it does, the [Issues tab](https://github.com/mihoillo/Chumpy/issues) is the place.

**What's inside**
- VLESS, VMess, Trojan, Shadowsocks, SOCKS, Hysteria2, WireGuard
- Subscriptions: base64 link lists, Clash YAML, raw Xray JSON — balancers included
- Per-app bypass, routing, auto-reconnect, delay test
- Material 3 Expressive, English and Russian

**Which file**
- `arm64-v8a` — most phones
- `armeabi-v7a` — old 32-bit ones
- `universal` — both cores aboard; works anywhere, twice the weight

Android 8.0 or newer.
